entry.name: heroImage
entry.label: Image on the hero card; empty follows this screen's wallpaper

entry.name: heroFor
entry.label: The image the position below was set for (it only applies to that one)

entry.name: heroX
entry.label: Horizontal focus of the hero image, 0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge)

entry.name: heroY
entry.label: Vertical focus of the hero image, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom)

entry.name: heroZoom
entry.label: Zoom of the hero image beyond filling the card

entry.name: wallTarget
entry.label: Screens the wallpaper view applies to: "all" or an output name

entry.name: wallFocus
entry.label: The screen the Theme page shows while it edits every screen (wallTarget "all")
